### Summary of Changes

This pull request introduces a new onboarding workflow for first-time users, streamlines the user interface by removing the old workflow steps from the main workspace, and enhances accessibility and mobile responsiveness. It also updates the help modal content and adjusts the free allowance for Classic reports.

### Highlights

* **New Onboarding Workflow**: A new onboarding guide has been added to the Help modal, guiding users through creating their first report with clear steps.
* **UI Cleanup**: The old workflow steps have been removed from the main workspace, leaving only the core fields (student name, notes, protocol selection) visible.
* **Accessibility Improvements**: Added `aria-modal` and `role="dialog"` to the access modal for better screen reader support. Also added `aria-label` to the close button in the access modal.
* **Mobile Responsiveness**: Improved mobile layout handling, ensuring no horizontal overflow on various screen sizes (390px, 768px, 900px, 980px).
* **Help Modal Enhancements**: The Help modal now includes a detailed guide section and can be closed by clicking outside the modal or pressing Escape.
* **Free Allowance Update**: The free allowance for Classic reports has been reduced from 20 to 5 per month.

### Changelog

<details>
<summary>Click here to see the changelog</summary>

* **index.html**
  * Added a new onboarding guide within the Help modal, including steps for creating a report.
  * Removed the old workflow steps from the main workspace.
  * Updated the free allowance text in the help section from '20 Classic reports' to '5 Classic reports'.
  * Added `role="dialog"` and `aria-modal="true"` to the access modal.
  * Added `aria-label` to the close button in the access modal.
  * Added a new `first-guide-details` element containing a detailed guide.
  * Added `access-modal` class to the license modal.
  * Added `id="licenseModalCloseBtn"` to the close button in the access modal.
* **tests/test-browser-smoke.cjs**
  * Updated tests to reflect the new onboarding workflow location within the Help modal.
  * Added tests for mobile layout and font sizes.
  * Added tests for protocol armory and card layouts.
  * Added tests for accessibility improvements (aria-modal, role="dialog", aria-label).
  * Added tests for help modal closing behavior (Escape key, clicking outside).
* **tests/test-customer-copy.cjs**
  * Added a new test file to verify customer-facing copy, including free allowance, signup modal text, and protocol selector counts.

</details>

### Merge Readiness

The pull request is ready for merging. It introduces significant improvements to the user experience, accessibility, and mobile responsiveness, while also updating the free allowance for Classic reports. All tests pass, ensuring that the changes do not introduce any regressions. I am unable to directly approve this pull request, and recommend that others review and approve this code before merging.
